strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter then All-Gather per Stage
strategies.desc: Replace each all_reduce with reduce_scatter (producing local shard S elements) followed by all_gather to reconstruct full vector before next coupling operation. 16 collective dispatches (2 per stage × 8 stages). Trades increased dispatch count for potentially better bandwidth utilization on ring topologies where RS+AG can pipeline better than monolithic all_reduce.

strategies.name: Fused Coupling with Chunked All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Split the world_size*2048 vector into K chunks and pipeline all_reduce operations across chunks while performing coupling/decoupling computations on already-reduced chunks. Approximately 8*K dispatches but enables compute-communication overlap. Requires careful dependency management to ensure stage k+1 doesn't start until stage k completes on all chunks.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology by performing intra-node all_reduce (within each node's devices) followed by inter-node all_reduce for each of 8 stages. 16 collective dispatches (2 per stage × 8 stages) but each operates on different communicator groups. Reduces cross-node bandwidth pressure by leveraging faster intra-node interconnect for majority of data movement.

strategies.name: Bidiagonal Computation Offload to Rank-Local
strategies.desc:
After first all_reduce, each rank extracts only its needed shards (r and r+1) via indexed copy, computes coupling locally in isolation, then uses all_gather to reconstruct for next stage instead of full all_reduce. 1 all_reduce + 7 all_gather dispatches (8 total). Smaller per-dispatch payload for all_gather (only updated shards) but requires careful indexing and may suffer from load imbalance.
